title: To Adapt or Not to Adapt? Selective Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a prominent strategy for adapting vision-language models to distribution shifts during inference. We conduct a per-sample analysis of model predictions before and after adaptation, and observe two failure modes in existing TTA methods that echo previous work. Adaptations are frequently negligible, yielding no change in the model's predictions, and more severely, they can be detrimental by flipping previously correct predictions to incorrect ones. This naturally raises a question: Can we identify and skip such negligible or harmful adaptations? In this work, we introduce a new problem of selective adaptation, which aims to determine whether a given test sample should undergo adaptation or be skipped. translated_title: 适应还是不适应？视觉语言模型的选择性适应
translated_abstract: 测试时适应（TTA）已成为在推理过程中使视觉语言模型适应分布偏移的一种重要策略。我们对适应前后的模型预测进行了逐样本分析，观察到现有TTA方法中存在两种失效模式，这与先前的研究结果相呼应。适应通常是微不足道的，不会对模型的预测产生任何改变；而更严重的是，适应可能是有害的，会将原本正确的预测翻转为错误的。这自然引出一个问题：我们能否识别并跳过这些微不足道或有害的适应？在本工作中，我们引入了一个新的问题——选择性适应，旨在确定给定的测试样本是否应该进行适应或被跳过。为此，我们提出了跨增强相似度（CAS），这是一个简单的基线方法，仅当跨增强视图的预测表现出低相似度时才执行适应。值得注意的是，CAS不仅能够预先……
tldr: 本文提出“选择性适应”这一新问题，并设计了跨增强相似度（CAS）方法，通过仅在增强视图间预测相似度较低时才执行适应，从而识别并跳过测试时适应中微不足道或有害的适应操作。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the new problem of selective adaptation and proposes Cross-Augmentation Similarity (CAS), a simple baseline that performs adaptation only when predictions across augmented views exhibit low similarity, thereby identifying and skipping negligible or harmful test-time adaptations.
